business_summary: Liuzhou Iron&Steel Co., Ltd produces and sells iron and steel products. It offers carbon steel plates; profiles; plates; billets; chemical products; gas; low alloy steel plates; steel plates without trimming; steel plates for molds; ship plates; boiler and pressure vessel plates; bridge plates; steel plates; pipeline steel; automotive girder plates; high-rise buildings; steel plates for automobiles; steel wire rods; cold rolled steel; galvanized steel; hot rolled steel strips; pickled plates, medium and thick plates, ribbed steel bars, high-speed wire rods, and medium-sized steel and other products. The company is also involved in ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing; steel rolling; mechanical processing and repair; cement manufacturing; mining; oxygen production; and automobile cargo transportation activities. Its products are used in automobiles, home appliances, petrochemicals, machinery manufacturing, energy transportation, ships, bridges, construction, metal products, nuclear power, electronic instruments, medical equipment, kitchenware and bathroom, and construction and decoration applications. The company was founded in 1958 and is based in Liuzhou, China. Liuzhou Iron&Steel Co., Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Guangxi Liuzhou Iron and Steel Group Co., Ltd.
